body:
We supply vape shops and other adult-only retailers with volume pricing across our catalog of disposables, e-liquids, pods and pouches. If you run or manage a retail business and want to buy in bulk, this guide explains who qualifies, how to apply, what to prepare, how pricing and payment work, how shipping and delivery apply to larger orders, how to plan your first order and what your responsibilities are as a reseller. It is written for adults aged 21 and over and for businesses that sell only to adults. It is general information, not legal advice, and you are responsible for following the laws that apply to your business.

## Who qualifies
Wholesale is for licensed retailers who can provide a business license or tax ID, and who sell only to adults aged 21 and over. Requirements vary by state and local law, and you are responsible for your own compliance, including any retail license, tax registration or product-listing rules in your area. We may ask for documents that show that your business is a registered retailer, and we may decline to supply a business that cannot show that it can lawfully sell vapor products. Our [wholesale page](/wholesale/) describes tax-exempt ordering for registered businesses, which applies where your documents support it.

## Why buy wholesale
Volume pricing lowers your cost per unit, which matters when you resell. Buying in bulk also reduces how often you reorder, which saves time and shipping costs, and it lets you stock a range of brands and flavors so your customers find what they want. Our catalog covers popular disposable brands, e-liquids in several bottle sizes, nicotine salts, pods, kits and nicotine pouches, so you can build a mixed order in one place.

## How to apply
Use the form on the [wholesale page](/wholesale/). Tell us your company name, your tax or resale ID, your contact details, your estimated monthly volume and what you want to stock. Our team replies by email, usually with questions or a request for supporting documents. The form sends a saved copy to our dashboard, so your request does not get lost. If you prefer to talk first, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/), WhatsApp, phone or email, and we will take it from there. See [how to become a wholesale customer](/blog/how-to-become-a-wholesale-customer/) for the step-by-step process.

## What to prepare
A complete application gets a faster reply. Have these ready:

- **Business name and legal entity.**
- **Tax or resale ID,** and a copy of your retail license where your state requires one.
- **A shipping address** that can accept adult-signature deliveries and has someone present during business hours.
- **A list of brands, products and quantities** you are interested in.
- **Your estimated monthly volume,** so that we can suggest sensible pricing tiers.
- **Contact details** for the person who will place orders and receive deliveries.

## Pricing
Volume pricing depends on quantity and product. It is not a single published list, because costs differ by brand and because quantities change what we can offer. Browse the [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) ranges to build a list of what you want, then send it to us with the quantities. We reply with availability and a quote for the items. Mixed orders are welcome, and you can negotiate quantities where it makes sense. Prices we quote are for the products and quantities we list, and we confirm them in writing before you pay.

### How the discounts relate
The 10% discount for cryptocurrency and gift cards applies to retail orders at checkout. For wholesale quotes, we explain whether it applies and how it combines with volume pricing when we send the quote. Do not assume that discounts stack until we confirm in writing.

## Payment
Wholesale orders can use the same payment options as retail: cryptocurrency, gift cards, Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime, subject to what suits the size of the order. Large amounts are best handled with a quote, because some methods have transfer limits, and because we want to confirm the total before you send it. Cryptocurrency handles large amounts well, and stablecoins give an exact figure. Read [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/) and [how to pay with Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/) to choose.

## Shipping
Bulk orders ship under the same adult-signature rules as any other order. A parcel or pallet needs an adult aged 21 or older to sign and show photo ID. Our regional carriers deliver according to the estimates in the [shipping policy](/shipping/): 3 to 7 business days for the West Coast and 11 to 18 business days for the eastern half of the US, after 24 to 72 business hours of processing. Large orders may be reviewed for accuracy and compliance before shipping, which can add a little time. Plan your ordering around those lead times so that you do not run out of stock.

## Planning your first order
- **Start with your best sellers.** Look at what your customers buy most, and order enough for a few weeks.
- **Mix a few new products.** Adding a few new flavors lets you test demand without a large commitment.
- **Balance size and freshness.** E-liquid and pouches keep best in cool, dark storage, and large stocks should be rotated. See [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/) and [how to store nicotine pouches](/blog/how-to-store-nicotine-pouches/).
- **Check your local rules** on flavors and listings before you order, because some products may not be lawful to sell in your area.
- **Allow for lead times,** especially if you are in the eastern half of the country.

## Your responsibilities as a reseller
As a retailer, you are responsible for your own licensing, taxes and age checks. Verify the age of every customer, display required warnings, store products responsibly and follow local rules on flavors, packaging and advertising. We supply products to registered businesses, but we cannot take responsibility for how they are sold. Read [state and local vape laws explained](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/), [the PACT Act explained](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/) and [what 21+ age verification means](/blog/what-21-plus-age-verification-means/).

## Returns and problems
Our returns policy applies to wholesale orders as well: returns must be arranged within 30 days, with an RMA, and opened or used items cannot be returned. A 15% restocking fee applies to refunds, and shipping fees are not refunded. Puffco products do not qualify for refunds or exchanges. For wholesale orders, check the quote for any terms that differ, and ask us if you are unsure before you pay. If a parcel arrives damaged, photograph it and email us immediately. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/) and [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Is there a minimum wholesale order?
Minimums depend on the products and the pricing we offer. Tell us your target volume and we will confirm what applies.

### Can I place wholesale orders through the website?
Smaller trade orders can use the cart. Larger orders are best arranged with our team so that we can quote them. We will tell you which route suits your order.

### Do you offer recurring orders?
We can discuss regular supply once you have placed a first order. Tell us your expected monthly volume.

### Can you ship to several store locations?
Each parcel ships to one address, so multiple locations are handled as separate shipments. Tell us what you need.

### Do you supply customers who sell online?
We supply registered retailers who sell lawfully. Online sellers must comply with the rules for remote sales, including age verification and signature on delivery. Ask us if you are unsure.

## Next steps
Read [how to become a wholesale customer](/blog/how-to-become-a-wholesale-customer/) and [bulk buying tips](/blog/bulk-buying-vapes-save-money/), then send your application through the [wholesale page](/wholesale/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A worked example of a first wholesale order
A small vape shop in Nevada wants to stock disposables, a few bottles of salt e-liquid and nicotine pouches. The owner submits the form with the company name, resale ID, a copy of the state retail license and a list: three disposable brands in eight flavors each, two e-liquid brands and two pouch brands, with quantities. We reply within a few business days confirming that the documents are in order and send a quote with unit prices and a total. The owner asks to swap two flavors, we update the quote and confirm in writing. The owner pays with USDC on Solana, and the payment is matched automatically. After 24 to 72 business hours of processing, the order ships to the shop address, where the owner signs with photo ID. Because the shop is on the West Coast, transit is 3 to 7 business days. The owner checks the delivery against the invoice, photographs one dented box and emails us, and we sort it out.

## Questions to ask yourself before ordering
How fast do these products sell in my shop? How much shelf and storage space do I have? How long can I hold stock before it goes stale? What do local rules allow me to sell? How will I verify the age of every customer? Answering these before you order helps you choose quantities that match demand, rather than tying up money in stock you cannot move.

## Keeping a steady ordering rhythm
Wholesale works best as a rhythm rather than a one-off. Many retailers place a larger order every few weeks, topping up fast sellers and adding a few new products each time. Tell us what sold and what did not, and we can suggest changes. Keep notes of lead times for your region, and reorder before you run low, so that a delay in transit does not leave shelves empty.
